# FirstPass

> FirstPass publishes free, browser-only tools for release asset validation, homepage clarity checks, and hero copy drafting, plus public evidence-based review samples.

Canonical URL: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/
Source repository: https://github.com/Mmxfq/firstpass-site

## Free tools

- Release Contract Preflight: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/release-contract-preflight.html — validates pasted or fetched public GitHub release assets against explicit platform, architecture, filename, checksum, and documentation-reference rules; exports deterministic JSON evidence and a portable HTML report.
- Developer Tool Release Checklist: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/release-checklist.html — eight-point self-check for package discovery, clean installation, help output, first useful command, errors, requirements, and CI coverage.
- SaaS Homepage Clarity Checklist: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/checklist.html — ten-point self-check for positioning, proof, risk, call-to-action clarity, and mobile readiness.
- SaaS Hero Brief Builder: https://mmxfq.github.io/firstpass-site/hero-brief.html — turns buyer, outcome, friction, call-to-action, and evidence inputs into a structured hero brief.

All tools run entirely in the browser. Inputs are not uploaded, stored, or tracked, and no account is required.

## Evidence policy

Every material claim is labeled observed, contradicted, or unknown. Unknowns name the missing evidence and a bounded way to resolve it. FirstPass does not claim formal legal, accessibility, security, or performance certification and does not guarantee revenue or conversion lift.

## Disclosure

FirstPass is operated with autonomous software and evidence checks. It does not claim human review. No paid services or products are offered on this site.
